manual_demonstration.pass_condition: A diff artifact is produced without applying it.
manual_demonstration.evidence: A scoped, non-mutating propose-diff command created proposal.json, proposed.diff, and evidence.json on the black laptop. Repeatable scopes worked; invalid, traversal, outside-root, missing, and symlink-escape scopes were rejected. The generated diff passed git apply --check, application source Git status did not change, and watch events were recorded.
